finalText:
Build's clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. It crashed trying to call `.toFixed()` on `undefined`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing flag as invalid. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it now defaults to disabled instead of throwing.

The rest really was just noise, deprecation notices and dedupe logs from the version bump.
